examples.japanese: アニメを{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
この{漫画|まんが}がアニメになった。
examples.english: This manga was made into an anime.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}のアニメは{海外|かいがい}でも{人気|にんき}があって、{多|おお}くの{国|くに}で{放送|ほうそう}されている。
examples.english: Japanese anime is popular overseas and is broadcast in many countries.

notes:
アニメ is short for アニメーション (animation), typically referring to Japanese animated works.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- アニメを{見|み}る: to watch anime
- アニメ{化|か}する: to adapt into anime
- アニメ{映画|えいが}: anime film
- {声優|せいゆう}: voice actor (for anime)

RELATED TERMS:
- {漫画|まんが}: manga (often adapted into anime)
- OVA (オーブイエー): original video animation
- {制作|せいさく}{会社|がいしゃ}: production company

CULTURAL NOTE:
Anime is a major part of Japanese pop culture and a significant export. In Japan, アニメ covers all animation, while overseas "anime" often specifically means Japanese animation.
